title: W1 VERIFY (census + integrity): the live registry census against the frozen ledger
description: The mechanical half of wave 1's verify cluster, and the only instrument in this system that can catch a duplicate record: conflicts is blind to perfect clones by design, and a temp-root replay cannot see the live registry's census. Nothing compared the LIVE registry against an authorized ledger the last time this failed, which is why fourteen records existed for a twelve-row ledger and every check passed. You arrive to find T-379 in review: replaying it and verdicting it is part of this task's charge and is what lifts your own cascade gate - do the replay FIRST and verdict on your own evidence, never on the producer's word. Rotation (F6): your identity must have produced no artifact in this epic.
acceptance_criteria: CENSUS ARITHMETIC PROVEN, NOT SAMPLED: run python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py list --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(r)); print(','.join(x['id'] for x in r))" and ls .harness/precedents/PR-*.json | wc -l yourself, list the ids, and prove records-on-disk == 34 + N1 exactly, with every new id mapped 1:1 to a ledger row CD-NN. A record with no ledger row is an unauthorized publication and a REJECT. A ledger row with no record is a silent skip and a REJECT.

CLONE HUNT, because the tooling cannot do it for you: for every pair of new records sharing a subject, and for every new record against the 34 pre-existing ones, compare (ratio, subject, title). A byte-identical ratio pair is the PR-030/PR-031 shape - the field-by-field diff whose only differing keys are id and published_at. Paste your method and its result.

REPLAY EVERY PUBLISH COMMAND IN A UNIQUELY-NAMED TEMP ROOT (--root <scratch>/w1-verify-<unique>), never against the live registry, and confirm each produces a structurally identical record. A command that cannot be re-run as quoted is a REJECT: the transcript is the evidence, and an unreproducible transcript is not evidence.

NO HAND-EDITS - PROVE IT, DO NOT ASSUME IT: for every minted id find its precedent_published event in .harness/logs/events.jsonl (paste the grep) and confirm the record file's field order and defaults match a CLI-minted record rather than a hand-authored one. A record with no publish event is a REJECT.

BASELINES RE-MEASURED BY YOU: conflicts, cite --all and stale, with exit codes and complete findings; account for every delta against python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py conflicts -> '1 conflict finding(s) across 34 record(s)', exit 3, detector 5, PR-001's dangling P-023 token; python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py cite --all | tail -1 -> '1 of 185 citation(s) dangling', exit 3; python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py stale | tail -1 -> 'stale: 17 reconsideration candidate(s) across 34 record(s)', exit 3; ls .harness/precedents/PR-*.json | wc -l -> 34. All four measured live 2026-08-13. PR-001's dangling P-023 finding MUST still be present - if it is gone and T-365 did not land the ledger entry, that is a CD3 violation and an automatic REJECT.
SELF-CONFIRMATION CHECK: every new record has confirmation_status unconfirmed and confirmed_by null. A producer-confirmed record is an automatic REJECT.

TIER-EVIDENCE AUDIT (CD6): for each new record run python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py cite PR-NNN, resolve every tier_evidence token yourself, and confirm both that the tier's required token KIND is present and that the anchor names a fact you can actually check. A tier-2 record whose P-NNN token does not resolve in state.json evolution is a REJECT; so is a tier claim resting on a token that resolves but proves nothing.

STATE.JSON UNTOUCHED: git diff -- .harness/state.json accounted key by key; only blackboard.py's own agents.<id> counters may differ. evolution.accepted_mutations still holds 27 entries with P-023, P-027 and P-028 absent.

TEST FLOOR: python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_precedent*.py" prints a 'Ran N tests' line with N >= 252 and OK (252 measured live 2026-08-13 by the planner; if N is higher, name T-376 as the landed repair rather than absorbing the delta) (quote your own Ran N line, not the producer's); python3 -m py_compile .harness/bin/precedent.py exit 0; git status --porcelain .harness/bin/ empty.

P-022 self-done is then available to you here (role verifier, --agent different from this task's creator); state in your note that you produced no artifact in this epic.

FORWARD THE CANONICAL SET: your note MUST end with the authoritative list of wave-1 record ids, plus any record T-381 must NOT audit as legitimate. T-381 consumes exactly that list; auditing the raw directory instead of your list is how a clone gets read as doctrine.
